banner.title: The character round - Smith's new-view Dwarves (folios 26-27), Stock and Lane's birth tables (folios 14-16) and the Pulsipher Eldar deltas (folios 20-21)
banner.provenance: Pinned from The Dragon Vol. 1 No. 3 (October 1976): folios 26-27, Larry Smith's A New View of Dwarves - the nine-level Fighting Man ladder with the dice-plus forms split to base and bonus, the kingship of the seven families with Durin on the 7-8 of a d8, the Greyhawk cleric and thief options with their swapped dice, the fourteen abilities, the reaction modifiers with the Goblins-and-Orcs auto attack, and the folk wisdom; folios 14-16, Brad Stock and Brian Lane's Birth Tables for D&D - the ten-table character generation system from social class through sibling rank, social rank wealth, the three skills groups, the nobility rolls with the royalty rules, the adventurer fathers, the race rolls with the dice grid and requirement bands, and the previous-experience multipliers; folios 20-21, Lewis Pulsipher's letter - the Silvan, Sindar and Eldar-proper system with the True Sight powers and the over-sea doctrine, as deltas against the R888 Smith Eldar pin. The editors ran the Smith rebuttal beside the letter; both systems stand, the deltas noted, never silent.
banner.sentinel: The variant-layer doctrine holds: Dragon ink is never core 1e canon. The '00' percentile convention CONVERTS to 100 throughout the birth tables and the 'nil' bands pin as 0, every conversion noted, never silent; the race requirement grid's printed 'any' CONVERTS to the 3-18 range; the ladder's dice-plus forms split to base and bonus; the auto-attack reaction row pins AS SCANNED as the sentinel 9; the OCR's split Very-Wealthy rows and column shifts in the social-rank tables, the garbled ladder footnote, the royalty table's interleaved wealth labels and the sibling note 'No one receives Allowance' ride AS SCANNED, unpinned or noted, no figure pixels to check; the crafts list pins as a count with the names in the audit comment; the Pulsipher system rides as DELTAS against the R888 Smith pin, both authored systems standing side by side on the variant layer, never a rewrite.

audit_comment: THE CHARACTER ROUND - round D of the issue-3 walk. Smith's new-view Dwarves: the nine-level Fighting Man ladder (Dwarf through Dwarf King at 10+1 and 320,000, the printed dice-plus forms split to base and bonus, fighting as Man+2 down to Men and back), the 17-Strength 7th and 18-Strength 8th gates with the 12-Intelligence 12-Wisdom footnote pinned as scanned, the seven families and the Durin 7-8 of the d8, the kingship rules, the Greyhawk cleric option (15 Wisdom, 7th at 17, 8th at 18, points on a d8), the thief's d6, the forbidden class list, the fourteen abilities (the 4-level saving-throw bonus, the +3 War Hammer, the 1-4 of a d6 detection with new construction automatic, the Goblin-Orc-Hobgoblin tongues with Gnome and Kobold spoken, the Giant Class +1/-1, the gem judging and the magic feeling, the Smith 9/9, Armorer 12/9 and Engineer 15 trade gates, the crossbow-and-shortbow rule, the six regular weapons with others at -1, the 17-Dexterity swim against the water fear, and the 12-Intelligence horse reluctance across the folio break), the reaction modifiers (the Goblins-and-Orcs auto attack pinned as the sentinel 9, the Sindar-Silvan-Elves-and-men -2, the others -1, the Hobbits-and-Noldor 0, the different Folk +1, the same Folk +2 and never attacking one's own), and the folk wisdom (maturity around 50, about 250 years, the hates, the unbroken oath). Stock and Lane's birth tables: social class, sibling rank with the orphan check and the first-son and bastard percents, the four wealth ladders (with the OCR's split Very-Wealthy rows pinned as scanned), the father's occupation routing, the three skills groups with the Group 1 banding notes, the first-five prohibition and the no-player-Adventurer rule, the Interpreter, Soldier and Orator edges, the twelve crafts, the nobility rolls (father's title, the royalty kinship with the immediate family's 1000 and 100, the never-orphan, raise-to-wealth, the reroll ignoring 96-00 and the one-notch title raise, the five position tables with their adventurer percents), the adventurer fathers (levels and classes by social class), the race rolls (Table 1 by class, the dice grid, the Table 2 requirement bands with 'any' converted to 3-18), and the previous-experience multipliers through the Noble x130. Pulsipher's Eldar deltas: the Silvan frame (no requirements, all D&D powers, disease and aging immunity, 8th/9th fighter and 4th/5th magic-user, Lawful or Neutral never evil), the Sindar (average abilities and 63 total, the 8th/9th magic-user, the 4th/5th/6th fighter), the Eldar proper (13 Wisdom, 67 total, the 11th one-path choice), the Eldar powers (the language per intelligence point, the calmed animals, the bird speech, the mind-to-mind range, the keen eyes, the True Sight with its per-level percents and the unawareness), the over-sea doctrine (one in a thousand, one in a hundred, one in ten thousand, no roll until maximum level, the Silvan never), the half-elf rule, and the deltas against the R888 Smith pin never silent. HONEST BOUNDARIES: the OCR's split and column-shifted rows ride as scanned; the royalty table's interleaved wealth labels pin nothing beyond the bands; the sibling note 'No one receives Allowance' garbles and pins nothing; the crafts pin as a count; all three clusters ride the variant layer.
